items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: They had a guy called James Alexander, drummer.

ctx.x: Well they're sitting in back here.

They're flying. No, he wouldn't leave New Orleans. That's how they got Joe Howard on the boat. But you're talking way before the people left. I'm talking, I'm going when we first started on the boat, see. They had Frank Duesen. Oh, gee. That's how they did. Yeah, we were first on the boat. Frank Duesen. They had a guy called James Alexander, drummer. And Manuel come on there for a while, Manuel Perez. Correct. Then we had Andrew Kimberl for a while, see. On trumpet, yeah. On trumpet, see.
